support.title: Поддержка
support.subtitle: Creator, sponsors, and YSK Limited — free product, real help
support.creatorBody: This OpenAI-compatible gateway is a free open-source product for running local models as an API. The project is maintained in the open; your feedback and bug reports matter.
support.sponsorBody: If this gateway saves you time, consider sponsoring development. Every bit helps keep it free for everyone.
support.walletsHint: Send only on the matching network. Double-check the address before you transfer.
support.yskBody: Need hands-on help beyond the free Admin panel? YSK Limited can provide:
support.yskLi1: Server install, hardening, and day-to-day ops
support.yskPrice: No public price list — email us and we will scope it to your setup.
support.helpBody: Email with OS, install / log path, and expected vs actual result. Every message is read.
support.docs: Full docs are in the repo README

business.title: Бизнес
business.subtitle: Enterprise deploy, OEM, integration, and partners — YSK Limited
business.deployBody: Run YSK Omni on your own hardware or private cloud, with the same Admin and OpenAI-compatible API.
business.deployLi3: API keys, model allowlists, and rate limits
business.deployLi4: Ops: queue, DDoS, reverse proxy, and PM2
business.oemBody: Embed the gateway in your product. Keep your brand on the Admin panel and client surfaces.
business.oemLi1: Ship local inference inside your own product
business.integrateBody: Connect existing accounts, pipelines, and monitoring to the gateway without rewriting clients.
business.integrateLi3: Image, video, speech, and transcription pipelines
business.partnerBody: Resellers and regional teams who introduce YSK Omni with their own stack.
business.contactBody: No public price list — email us and we will scope it to your environment.
